title: [Audit] 🔎 Elasticsearch Data Access
description: What data was read, by whom, through which transport action — including system indices.

config.content:
### What data was read or written in Elasticsearch, and by whom

See which indices each identity uses, the kinds of requests they made, any denied requests, and every touch of system or hidden indices. Raw records: [All audit events](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-all-events), [Raw signal feed](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-raw-signal-feed).

Related indices are grouped into one family, so a data stream and its daily backing indices read as a single row. Use it to confirm that sensitive data is reached only by the people and keys you expect.

**How to use it:** choose a Project, Identity type, Identity or Client IP in the controls and set the time picker. Empty denied and system-index panels usually mean all is well.

- This page counts all traffic, these dashboards’ own reads included: on a page about who reads what, those reads are the subject.
- A request counts once per index it names; shard copies and internal sub-steps are left out. Ranked tables show the top rows; the tiles count everything.
- Matrix: a blank cell means no reads, or too few to be among the 500 busiest identity–family pairs.
- System and hidden index access is expected from Kibana and platform automation; from anyone else, look closer.
- The chart legend’s totals leave out the partial bucket at the right edge, so they can run behind the tiles.
- Identities read as in the Identity dropdown, a Cloud API key shortened to “_4KEO… · Cloud API key”. The dropdowns apply to this page only; the links above do not carry them.

config.description: All Elasticsearch audit events in range. The line above the number compares it with the prior period of the same length.

Distinct index families named in requests. A data stream and its backing indices, or a run of dated indices, count as one family; system and hidden indices count once per area. Wildcard patterns are not counted.

"Any") OR project.name == ?project) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR api_key.name == ?identity OR user.name == ?identity OR user.name == REPLACE(REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", ""), "^Unnamed key of ", "") OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?identity_kind == "" OR ?identity_kind == "Any") OR (?identity_kind == "Person" AND user.email IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key (name not recorded)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Cloud API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Service account" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_service_account") OR (?identity_kind == "Failed sign-in" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) OR (?identity_kind == "Unattributed" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Other" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NOT NULL)) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name == ?identity) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key" AND ENDS_WITH(?identity, " · Cloud API key") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key" AND STARTS_WITH(?identity, "Unnamed key of ") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, "^Unnamed key of ", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name == ?identity) OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any") OR client.ip == TO_IP(CASE((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any"), null, ?client_ip))) | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*" OR elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("indices:data/read/esql/search_shards", "indices:data/read/esql/data"))) | STATS BY elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE LOCATE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, "*") == 0 AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE "<*" | EVAL family = REPLACE(REPLACE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | EVAL family = REPLACE(family, """[-.]\d{8}[-.T]?\d{6}(?:[-.].*)?$""", "*") | EVAL family = CASE(LEFT(family, 1) == ".", CONCAT(REPLACE(family, """^(?:\.ds-)?(\.(?:alert-actions|[^-._]+)).*$""", "$1"), "*"), family) | STATS `Index families` = COUNT_DISTINCT(family)
